Time: 3 min. Teaching intent: Retrieve prior knowledge before revealing the method.
Talk track: Could 12 be entered as a dimensionless CTE?
Expected answer / misconception: No. That would be a million-fold input error.
Visual: The three conditions identify what must be compared.
[Sources]

Time: 4 min. Teaching intent: Teach the mechanism or design rule.
Talk track: Unit conversion and temperature scale must be checked before a property enters a model. Trace the visual in order: raw value; unit conversion; model unit. Connect this mechanism to the worked example: Convert 12 ppm/K to 12 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ and record the valid temperature range.
Expected answer / misconception: Ask students to explain the link between adjacent elements; a conceptual diagram is not a measurement.
Visual: Native diagram encodes the causal or design relationship.
[Sources]
R6: NIST, Credibility Consideration for Digital Twins | https://www.nist.gov/publications/credibility-consideration-digital-twins-manufacturing
R7: IEEE TCPMT, Thermomechanical Challenges of 2.5-D Packaging | https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10256204

Time: 4 min. Teaching intent: Work the example step by step.
Talk track: Set up the case: Convert 12 ppm/K to 12 × 10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ and record the valid temperature range. Identify the starting information, state the reasoning step aloud, then ask what observation would check the conclusion. Stop before the next slide's question is answered.
Expected answer / misconception: Students must identify the input, the inference, and the check. 
Visual: Three-part reasoning path separates the example from its verification.

Time: 3 min. Teaching intent: Pause for an individual answer, then reveal and discuss.

Time: 4 min. Teaching intent: Teach the mechanism or design rule.
Talk track: A one-factor model sweep estimates decision sensitivity within its specified specimen and process. Trace the visual in order: α₁ = 8 ppm/K; α₁ = 7 ppm/K; warpage change. Connect this mechanism to the worked example: In the NCKU study, modeled X warpage changes from 7.340 to 6.431 mm when EMC lower-temperature CTE α₁ changes from 8 to 7 ppm/K. Calculate −0.909 mm and −12.4% relative to baseline.
Expected answer / misconception: Ask students to explain the link between adjacent elements; a conceptual diagram is not a measurement.
Visual: Native diagram encodes the causal or design relationship.
[Sources]
R6: NIST, Credibility Consideration for Digital Twins | https://www.nist.gov/publications/credibility-consideration-digital-twins-manufacturing
